extracted.name: Cherry Rhubarb Pie
extracted.description: This cherry rhubarb pie can be made with fresh or frozen rhubarb combined with cherry pie filling for a fruity and comforting springtime dessert.
ingredient_lines: 1 recipe Pastry for double-crust pie (9 inches)
instruction_lines: Combine rhubarb, cherry pie filling, sugar, and tapioca in a large bowl. Let stand for 15 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Pour filling into unbaked pie shell, and cover with pie crust. Brush top with milk, and sprinkle on sugar.
Bake in the preheated oven until pastry is golden and filling is bubbling, about 40 to 45 minutes.
